h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Mira Bhayandar

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Mira Bhayandar

items.pText: Mira Bhayandar is about 10 km from our factory in Vasai, just across the creek, so it is one of the easiest places in India for us to supply. Most enquiries here come from high-rise housing societies whose play area sits on a podium, a terrace or a narrow strip between towers. FunPlay Systems designs, manufactures and installs outdoor playground equipment for exactly these sites.

We have installed a playground for Raymond in Thane, a few kilometres further along. For your society or school, share the area available, the age group and photos, and tell us whether the space is on natural ground or on a slab. We will send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked and install with our own team once you approve.

props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Play areas on podiums and terraces

c: A podium or terrace slab is usually waterproofed, and drilling or digging into it can cause leaks in the floor below. On such sites we generally recommend a self-standing installation, where the equipment rests on its own base without breaking the slab. Check the load the slab can take with your structural engineer before you finalise larger pieces.

Rubber flooring over the slab cushions falls and protects the waterproofing. Mumbai's monsoon is heavy from June to September, so make sure the podium drains do not sit inside the play area. A compact

items.q: Can playground equipment go on a podium or terrace?
items.a: Yes, usually with a self-standing installation that does not break the waterproofed slab. Confirm the slab's load capacity with your structural engineer for larger structures.

items.q: How close is your factory to Mira Bhayandar?
items.a: About 10 km. Our factory is in Vasai East, just across the creek, so the equipment has only a short road trip to your site.

items.q: What flooring should go on a podium play area?
items.a: Rubber flooring. It cushions falls, protects the waterproofing underneath and dries quickly after rain. Keep drain outlets clear of the play area.
